The '''Imperial Morale Corps''' was an organization established by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It supplied [[Morale officer/Legends|morale officers]] to the Empire, who travelled to [[Planet/Legends|planets]] to promote and praise the work of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. [[Debin Karre]] served in the Imperial Morale Corps.
